notes.title: We're answering your questions.
notes.notes:
Thank you guys for choosing [b]The Works of Mercy![/b] We are reading a lot of comments, reviews, streams. You are frequently asking some questions so we'd like to answer them to make things clear.

[b]Q: What about graphics downgrade?[/b]
A: We had to remove some objects from the environment to reach a satisfying performance level. If it happened - sorry for not meeting your graphics expectations.

[b]Q: Game is too short![/b]
A: Try to discover every possible ending and understand the story. More fun guaranteed!

[b]Q: Is there a possibility to save the game?[/b]
A: No. The game was created as a very immersing and relatively short-time experience. We wanted you to play it once from beginning to the end. Please consider this when reviewing the title.

[b]Q: Any updates/fixes plans?[/b]
A: Yes, small bug fixes.

notes.title: TIPS
notes.notes:
Hey Guys,

A few hours left to the launch. The price is set on 14.99 USD - 15% discount. 

Have Fun!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers,

It is our deepest regret to inform you that the release date of The Works of Mercy, which was originally scheduled on the 7th of June, has been postponed. The extra time will be used to polish the quality of the game to the highest standards. We would like to sincerely apologize to all those who have been awaiting the release of the game.  We sincerely thank you for your patience and hope that when you get to play the game, you will agree the wait will have been worth it. The new release date to be announced soon. 

Best regards,
PENTACLE
